name: Project Portfolio Management
summary: A plan registry and project-management tool: one recursive plan collection with an optional kind label, a Rust matcher library for explainable duplicate detection, a loco.rs REST service (governance, scheduling, cost, approvals, controlled documents), and a SvelteKit UI.
